record.body: Signature urban soundscapes are designed city soundscapes in which Signature anthrophony dominates: designed traffic, construction, and aircraft form a near-constant background, and Signature biophony must fit around it by stated adaptation rules, singing louder, higher, or at quieter times. The design states the adaptation rules and their ceilings, beyond which a Signature caller type is defined to disappear from the noisiest districts, modeling the real urban filter without claiming any real city's data. This record covers Signature biophony and Signature anthrophony together, kept distinct, with Signature geophony as the third layer in the background.

demo.code:
TITLE = 'Signature Urban Soundscapes: Designed Anthrophony Dominance'
import math
BIO = 52
GEO = 44
ANTH = 70
tot = 10 * math.log10(10 ** (BIO / 10.0) + 10 ** (GEO / 10.0) + 10 ** (ANTH / 10.0))
dom = 'biophony' if BIO >= GEO and BIO >= ANTH else ('geophony' if GEO >= ANTH else 'anthrophony')
print('Record: ' + TITLE)
print('Biophony: %.1f decibels' % BIO)
print('Geophony: %.1f decibels' % GEO)
print('Anthrophony: %.1f decibels' % ANTH)
print('Combined soundscape level: %.1f decibels' % tot)
print('Dominant layer: ' + dom)
print('Layers are mixed in arithmetic but kept distinct in description.')
demo.expected_output:
Record: Signature Urban Soundscapes: Designed Anthrophony Dominance
Biophony: 52.0 decibels
Geophony: 44.0 decibels
Anthrophony: 70.0 decibels
Combined soundscape level: 70.1 decibels
Dominant layer: anthrophony
Layers are mixed in arithmetic but kept distinct in description.
